source.document: Kodak Ektachrome 100 Plus Professional Film (EPP), publication E-113
source.credit: Eastman Kodak Company; original manufacturer measurements and graph content

epp-characteristic.conditions: Panel 'Characteristic Curves'. Exposure: Daylight, 1/100 second. Process: E-6. Densitometry: Status A. Curves labelled B, G, R; sorted by maximum density, which reproduces that order.

epp-sensitivity.conditions: Panel 'Spectral-Sensitivity Curves'. Effective exposure: 1.4 seconds. Process: E-6. Densitometry: E.N.D., Density 1.0. Sensitivity = reciprocal of exposure (ergs/cm^2) required to produce specified density. Traces label the Yellow-, Magenta- and Cyan-forming layers; sorted by peak wavelength as b, g, r. Negative axis values are printed with an overline, which extract_graphs negates. Frame x-axis calibrates to 249.3-745.1 nm (box extends past the 250/750 labels); x_tolerance widened to 10.0.

epp-dye.conditions: Panel 'Spectral-Dye-Density Curves': Normalized dyes to form a visual neutral density of 1.0 for a viewing illuminant of 5000 K. Process: E-6. Four traces: Yellow, Visual Neutral, Magenta, Cyan.

film.name: *Kodak Ektachrome 100 Plus EPP
film.base_density_note: Not on the sheet. The dye panel is normalised to a visual neutral of 1.0 and plots no D-min, and the characteristic minimum is a status-A reading, not a spectral curve. A flat 0.10 is assumed, within the 0.09-0.13 range the shipped positives carry. Assumption, not a measurement.
film.channel_dmin_note: Per-channel minima are read off the characteristic curves and subtracted before unmixing, so the fitted dye amounts reach zero at full exposure.
film.sensitivity_note: PCHIP of the three plotted log-sensitivity traces; engine covers 380-780 nm, each trace is used only over its own plotted span and is unmeasured elsewhere. Relative shape only; the panel's E.N.D. density-1.0 criterion is not an absolute speed.
film.density_tolerance_note: Gate on the unmixed dye amounts, not plotted density. 0.02 dye-amount units is about 0.8% of the 2.5-2.8 unit range used for the sibling Ektachrome preparations.
film.midgray_note: Rendering convention: engine log exposure zero is placed where the green channel's total status-A density equals -log10(0.184), the 18.4% reference grey this repository uses elsewhere. Not absolute ISO metering.
film.antihalation_note: Not stated on the sheet. Taken from shipped kodak_ektachrome_100, the nearest E-6 sibling, rather than guessed; it drives the halation preset only.

print.note: A reversal film: scanned directly, no print stage.

sampling.method: Constrained positive normal-CDF mixture, four components per channel, fitted on mirrored log exposure because the engine evaluates a positive's model with a negated argument.

adaptation_donor.reason: Nearest shipped E-6 reversal sibling; spectral adaptation parameters cannot be derived in this repository, so they are borrowed and the borrow is recorded in the profile.

authorship: New source extraction, preparation recipe and profile prepared with Claude for this repository, 2026-11-05. Axis calibration derived from the page by scripts/bw_expansion/extract_graphs.py (including overline-negation of the sensitivity axis). No donor stock curves copied: this sheet publishes its own C, M and Y dye curves plus a visual neutral. New profile preparation and profile data released under CC BY-SA 4.0.
